answer: An EigenTrust-style score decays exponentially with a defined temporal half-life, so reputation must be renewed through sustained honest service rather than banked indefinitely. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates trust only through credible interactions; a freshly spawned sybil, including one labeled wharf, nebula, or canyon, has near-zero eigenvector centrality and negligible influence, and therefore cannot meet consensus thresholds before earning durable trust.
